nodes.label: 2048 Building Sprite Family (building-e1..e12)
nodes.rationale: The Merge Kingdom GPT-generated asset family is reused as a distinct 2048 city-upgrade skin so the board reads as real objects, while the classic numeric tile values stay visible and authoritative.

nodes.label: Removed tile-e* Sprites
nodes.rationale: tile-e1..e12 were deleted together with the unmounted React PlayArea.tsx that was their only referencer; the source sheet is retained outside the repo instead of shipping dead art.

nodes.label: 2048 Phaser Play Surface
nodes.rationale: The Phaser scene is the single play surface; the retired React PlayArea was not a second game.

nodes.label: generate-banner.mjs Deterministic Banner Generator
nodes.rationale: Original vector art (SVG -> sharp -> webp/avif, deterministic seed) replaces a legacy marketing banner that baked in its own typography and a near-black logo card. The replacement carries no lettering, keeps a calm centre band, and holds the prize-wheel motif right-of-centre where the scrim has faded.

nodes.label: MiniAppHomeShell Full-Bleed Banner Scrim
nodes.rationale: The platform shell paints the app banner full-bleed behind the live headline under only a soft white scrim, so any baked-in copy ghosts through the real title — worst on mobile where the hero crops to the centre ~26% of the artwork. This host behaviour dictates what app banner art may contain.

nodes.label: officialGasTokenPhaserUrl Shared GAS Token Asset
nodes.rationale: Every visible GAS mark loads from the shared official token asset; the app ships no hand-drawn GAS or NEO logo.

nodes.label: minigame-everyday Reference-Only Exclusion
nodes.rationale: IcedSoul/minigame-everyday lacks per-resource license evidence (README claims MIT but the snapshot has no root license file), so no code or art is copied from it across the minigame apps; it stays reference-only.

nodes.label: MiniAppRedEnvelope Legacy Contract
nodes.rationale: Testnet 0xfa1b7240fead2a63999c02defa3aec5eb274a919 and mainnet 0x5f371cc50116bb13d79554d96ccdd6e246cd5d59 expose standalone red-envelope methods only; neither exposes the RangeGasPool or direct-credit ABI this app consumes, so both were removed from the active manifest contracts map.

nodes.label: PlatformSocial RangeGasPool Artifact
nodes.rationale: Local contracts/build/PlatformSocial.nef (checksum 1654231107) has the required RangeGasPool and credit methods but is not the artifact deployed at either published address, so no ABI or bytecode compatibility proof exists for a paid lane.

nodes.label: Same-Transaction Runtime.GetRandom Draw
nodes.rationale: Drawing inside the claim transaction with Runtime.GetRandom is not a proof-carrying flow and stays vulnerable to selective abort/retry across blocks.

nodes.label: Oracle VRF / Request-Settle Randomness Requirement
nodes.rationale: Same-transaction randomness must be replaced by an Oracle VRF or a non-cancellable request/settle protocol that produces a verifiable result after commitment.

nodes.label: OneGate Server-Claim Lane
nodes.rationale: Disabled: its payout log verifier checks GAS/Transfer, recipient, amount, HALT and return value but does not bind the transfer source to the campaign reward source or an authorised signer — a documented 44.26874529 GAS self-transfer (from == to) was accepted as a payout.

nodes.label: Gas Lucky Pool Stakes-Free Guest Phaser Lane
nodes.rationale: Guest draws use Web Crypto only and fail closed when secure randomness is unavailable; independent local-play, OneGate server-claim and RangePool flags stop one lane implicitly enabling another, and a local animation or submitted transaction never confirms a payout.

nodes.label: Gas Lucky Pool Paid-Lane Activation Gate
nodes.rationale: Ten ordered conditions (v2 deploy + exact hash/NEF/ABI binding, verifiable randomness, durable intent persistence, application-log HALT/FAULT discrimination, exact event and canonical readback, idempotency keys, authorised testnet sequence, OneGate payout-source binding, legacy liability migration) must all pass before source, runtime, manifest, payments and transaction capability are re-enabled together.

nodes.label: Expired Red-Envelope Liabilities
nodes.rationale: Testnet holds 238 expired envelopes with 13.69904177 GAS and mainnet 10 with 0.67196114 GAS; both contracts are unpaused with a zero automation anchor and no public refund/reclaim or direct-credit withdrawal path, so the balances must be migrated or settled rather than reused.

nodes.label: GasBox Capsule Machine & Prize Capsule Cutouts
nodes.rationale: Project-owned artwork present by commit 488fa04ec with SHA-256 fingerprints recorded; the frontend copies no external game art, generates no CSS illustrations and uses no emoji as product artwork.

nodes.label: Deployed MiniAppGasBoxV2 Binding 0x30e9d4a4
nodes.rationale: Same hash on MainNet (contract id 610) and TestNet (7356), update counter 0, lastMachineId/lastBetId/pendingBetCount all 0. Zero machines is a valid live empty state; the frontend does not fabricate samples.

nodes.label: GasBox ABI Compatibility Gate Evidence
nodes.rationale: The observed ABI (commit, settle, withdraw, withdrawPool, playCreditOf, pendingBetCount, getMachine, getItem) has no update method, and its deployed manifest extra describes settle-block Runtime.GetRandom — matching the pre-fixed-beacon revision. The live contract therefore cannot be upgraded in place and is the evidence backing the frontend compatibility gate.

nodes.label: GasBox Paid-Write Gate
nodes.rationale: Because the live hash is not the local fixed-beacon artifact, the app permits read-only browsing plus necessary recovery (settle of an existing pending bet, unused-credit withdrawal, revenue withdrawal, free-bankroll withdrawal, deactivation) while blocking every new economic exposure until a new deployment is verified and registry/manifest hashes are updated.

nodes.label: Network/Contract/Wallet-Scoped Pending Reveal Journal
nodes.rationale: Scoping the journal by network + contract + wallet lets a page reload restore Reveal without resubmitting the wager.

nodes.label: GasBox
nodes.rationale: A resource-led Neo N3 capsule game in browse-and-recovery mode: real transaction state drives motion, with no fake pull timer or simulated prize.

nodes.label: MiniAppGasBoxV2 Contract
nodes.rationale: Pays fungible NEO or GAS prizes only; no NFTs, machine trading, VRF, keeper settlement or AA session keys.

nodes.label: Fixed commitIndex+1 Beacon Commit/Reveal
nodes.rationale: Binding the reveal to the fixed next-block hash makes settlement permissionless and payable exactly once, unlike the older live version whose settle-block Runtime.GetRandom re-rolls on a later settle attempt.

nodes.label: GasBox Creator Contract Flow
nodes.rationale: createMachine, addItem (1-based weighted rows), memo-bound NEP-17 pool funding, setActive gated on free pool covering the largest prize, withdrawRevenue, and withdrawPool which returns only unreserved bankroll.

nodes.label: Decimal-String Base-Unit Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: All amount comparisons and writes use decimal-string base units so display numbers are derived from exact values rather than float-rounded ones.

nodes.label: Gomoku Original Vector Art Assets
nodes.rationale: Board, stones, last-move ring, win glow, result seal and difficulty badges are original to the repository — layered SVG rasterized with sharp at 2x then downscaled to webp, with no third-party asset packs.

nodes.label: Jump Rush
nodes.rationale: Published lane is the free local Phaser 3 game: supportsGameFi is false, the public operation list is empty, and the runtime forces stale non-guest launches back to guest mode before any wallet or chain operation can start.

nodes.label: PhaserPlayArea Single Play Surface
nodes.rationale: PlayArea.tsx is only a compatibility alias to PhaserPlayArea.tsx so the retired DOM/CSS prototype cannot be mistaken for a second game.

nodes.label: Jump Rush TestNet Contract 0xd98c65af
nodes.rationale: Kept in the manifest for maintenance and recovery only; the app neither advertises nor starts paid games against it.

nodes.label: Morpheus Wrapper / Contract Rule Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Contract and wrapper do not describe the same game: jump targets 10/20/30 vs 15/25/35, limits 60/90/120s vs 180/300/480s, minimum solve 15/30/45s vs 20/40/60s, three penalized undos vs zero, and the enclave route generator wraps its 32-byte stream after 16 width/gap pairs so long routes repeat.

nodes.label: Web Crypto Rejection-Sampled Route Generation
nodes.rationale: Local play builds the route with Web Crypto and rejection sampling, never falling back to Math.random or repeating a 32-byte seed pattern.

nodes.label: Validated Namespaced Run Recovery Storage
nodes.rationale: An unfinished run is restored only after its route, counters, timing and undo state pass validation; expired or malformed data is discarded, and storage or leaderboard failures never block gameplay.

nodes.label: Jump Rush GameFi Activation Gate
nodes.rationale: GameFi must not be enabled by changing the manifest alone: first align wrapper, contract and UI rules, prove the bind and settlement digest byte layouts, decide whether undo stays in the paid game, expose history fields explicitly, then run the full wallet/testnet recovery matrix before operations, payments, TEE permissions and supportsGameFi flip together.

nodes.label: Deployed Solved Event (seven fields)
nodes.rationale: The deployed event publishes neither jumps nor perfects, so the frontend reads only the seven available fields and leaves the perfect count explicitly unknown rather than inferring it.

nodes.label: Kenney Jumper Pack CC0 Sprites
nodes.rationale: Gameplay sprites (bunny poses, carrot, clouds, grass platforms) come from Kenney's Jumper Pack under CC0 1.0 Universal; the app banner and logo are project compositions derived from the same CC0 artwork.

nodes.label: Last Survivor Arena Artwork
nodes.rationale: last-survivor-arena.webp is the Phaser arena background; survivor-scene-art.webp was removed with the unmounted React PlayArea.tsx that was its only referencer.

nodes.label: scripts/generate-scene-art.mjs
nodes.rationale: Supports GPT Image plus a fallback provider, but historical raster assets carry no run metadata proving which provider produced them; if distribution requires provider-level provenance the art must be regenerated and its model, prompt, date and hashes recorded.

nodes.label: Canonical Binding and Durable Recovery Journal
nodes.rationale: Every write is bound to exact wallet, launch network, contract, action, amount and round before the wallet opens; recovery storage must pass a write/read/delete round trip before broadcast, and the pending record is held in session memory before the durable write so a storage failure cannot turn a broadcast into an apparent invitation to submit again.

nodes.label: Transaction Outcome Reader (HALT / FAULT / indexing delay)
nodes.rationale: Success requires the expected event from the bound contract plus an authoritative readback; indexing delay, HALT-with-missing-event and proven VM FAULT are each distinguished and none is converted into success.

nodes.label: Unavailable-vs-Zero Read Distinction
nodes.rationale: Unavailable round, quote, credit, key, history and wallet-balance reads are kept distinct from authoritative zero values; a failed wallet GAS read shows as unavailable, never as a confirmed 0.00 GAS.

nodes.label: Last Survivor
nodes.rationale: A bright Phaser 3 last-seat duel: local rivals steal the lead on an unpredictable rhythm, players trade safer large key packs against higher-scoring small packs, and must still hold the final seat when the countdown reaches zero.

nodes.label: MiniAppLastSurvivor Contract
nodes.rationale: TestNet 0xff122a6cf7f22a88d059d61a9d9c07e84a2b56b9 is the verified v1.1 pull-payment generation; MainNet 0x8e1e432e966357de8d7642564b744d3274a81bd0 is v1.0 with a different NEF, so no MainNet write is treated as equivalent.

nodes.label: Last Survivor Public ABI (buyKeys / settle / withdraw)
nodes.rationale: Reads getCurrentRound/getRound, currentKeyCost/keyCost, playerKeys and creditOf; writes buyKeys, settle and withdraw.

nodes.label: Permissionless Pull-Payment Settlement
nodes.rationale: Settlement is permissionless and credits the winner rather than pushing GAS during settle, so a hostile or failing recipient cannot block round rollover. The game deliberately uses no oracle or off-chain randomness.

nodes.label: Arithmetic Key-Price Curve
nodes.rationale: Base key price 10,000,000 base units with a 10,000 base-unit increment per key; each key extends the clock 30s, remaining time caps at 86,400s, and a single transaction buys at most 1,000 keys.

nodes.label: Last Survivor 中文说明 (Chinese README)
TestNet NEF Checksum Match Evidence
nodes.rationale: Local and live NEF checksums both 2859468900 with SHA-256 1d1a2ea8c05cbf05cf3994a9053768703409c036b75990ab47971e64f5cb43e1, plus HALT read probes and a passing two-wallet buy/expiry/settle/withdraw harness.

nodes.label: Last Survivor Paid Activation Matrix
nodes.rationale: The contract is proven but activation still needs one current end-to-end wallet/browser run against this exact build: connect without accidental buy, atomic shortfall transfer + buyKeys, exact KeysBought recovery across refresh and rollover, duplicate-submit lock during indexer lag, expiry + permissionless settle, winner withdraw readback, failure/reconnect recovery, and desktop plus mobile presentation. These stay explicit evidence rather than inferred success.

nodes.label: MiniAppMergeKingdom Contract 0x3fa9eb98
nodes.rationale: Deployed NEF checksum 4260724675 matches the local build exactly, and deployed getConfig values match the frontend's 0.02/0.10/0.20 GAS entry tiers, 0.10/0.50/1.00 GAS rewards, 3/5/10 minute limits, 30/60/120s minimum solve times and 64/256/1024 targets.

nodes.label: Morpheus Oracle 0x4b882e94
nodes.rationale: isAllowedCallback(mergeKingdom) is false and the contract's fee credit is 0 against a 1,000,000 base-unit request fee, so no oracle-backed settlement can complete yet.

nodes.label: Merge Kingdom Guest Phaser Lane
nodes.rationale: Phaser 3 resource-driven local merge game with Web Crypto spawn selection using unbiased rejection sampling, device-local board recovery, and no wallet, payment, oracle request or chain write in guest mode.

nodes.label: Merge Kingdom Activation Checklist
nodes.rationale: Checksum match, config match and a playable guest game are done; funding a reward pool covering every advertised tier, allowlisting the callback in Morpheus, funding the request-fee credit and running start/replay/finalize/expiry/withdrawal on testnet remain open before GameFi manifests may be enabled.

nodes.label: Empty freePool / reservedPool State
nodes.rationale: freePool, reservedPool and lastGameId are all 0, so the published app keeps supportsGameFi false, exposes no paid operation and makes no reward claim while retaining the historical GameFi implementation for readback, settlement recovery, expiry release and credit withdrawal.

nodes.label: Merge Kingdom GPT-Generated Tile Sprites
nodes.rationale: Generated for the July 2026 miniapp visual refresh (reference 019e7e7b-66c2-7c11-9e25-a0679675bbec) to replace number-only tiles with real merge-game objects.

hyperedges.label: Free guest Phaser lane shipped ahead of the paid GameFi lane
Per-game paid GameFi activation gate before supportsGameFi is enabled
Deployed-contract identity verification (hash, NEF checksum, ABI shape) gating writes
